feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 October 2026 11:20am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 16 October 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Continuing dry and mainly sunny at first, before a few showers begin to arrive from mid-afternoon and into the evening. Mainly moderate northwest winds, fresh near windward coasts. Maximum temperature 13°C.

A settled weekend ahead:
Tomorrow will be dry and mostly sunny with light northeast winds. Sunday will continue dry with sunny spells, again with light northeast winds. Daytime temperatures will be near average this weekend with maximums around 12°C, but cold at night.


##Outlook##

High pressure will gradually progress eastwards to Northern Europe on Monday, but conditions should remain mostly dry with variable cloud and light to moderate winds to start the week.
